lines.speaker: Tundra
lines.text: The Avalanche Ape, sitting quietly in the hot spring. You tamed it! Or tired it out. Either way, well done.

lines.speaker: Tundra
lines.text: Brr! Welcome to Snowcap Village, top of Frostfang Peak. Warm your toes in the hot spring if you like.

lines.speaker: Tundra
lines.text: Three Star Shards open the Summit Gate: one up the Ice Slide, one in the Crystal Caverns, one on the Frosted Pine Heights.

lines.speaker: Tundra
lines.text: Beyond the gate lives the Avalanche Ape. Make it belly-slide into the frozen pillars, then PLUNGE on its head!
